limitations.benchmark_outcome: RECOMMEND WITH CONDITIONS (recorded 2026-10-10 by A0 /claude/a0_atlas, as a declared amendment on WP-0A-CON-006, R0-238-4). Q0 (/claude/q0_sentinel) ran the short, forward-scoped benchmark the Product Owner directed (disposition Q2): task sheet evidence/WP-0A-CON-006/q0-a5-benchmark-tasks-2026-10-10.md (sealed key SHA-256 94013cc84328941a6072dfeb3a9f051af00c18d6d219432c5765c54dc8b63a5b, published as q0-a5-benchmark-key-2026-10-10.md), the run's answer as transcribed by A0 in a5-benchmark-answer-2026-10-10.md, and Q0's scoring in evidence/WP-0A-CON-006/q0-a5-benchmark-2026-10-10.md: T1, T2, T4 and T5 pass, T3 passes with condition, nothing fails and nothing is fabricated. The recommendation is forward-only and covers this run's role_scope only (the CTR-NTF-001 owner assessment and ratification); it is not that signature. Q0's condition, verbatim: **C-T3.** In `/claude/a5_loom`'s assessment and ratification of CTR-NTF-001 (WP-0A-CON-006 `open_blockers[1]`, `[2]`, `[19]`, `[22]`): **(a)** every bound and character class it ratifies (including `notification_id`, `message_key`, `deep_link.target_ref` and `dedupe_key`) is labelled either an owner **decision**, with the source line it rests on, or a declared **inference**, with its basis. **(b)** every fixture it cites as evidence for a rule is shown, by an executed probe with `test-kits/contracts/json-schema-subset.mjs`, to fail with that rule present and to validate with that rule alone deleted. Each probe's command and output are in the A5 file. **(c)** for every rule that a `const` enforces and that the assessment relies on, the A5 file states whether an **absent** property is also rejected, and names the fixture that isolates the absent case, shown as in (b) with `required` alone deleted. Where no such fixture exists, it says so. Q0 re-reads the A5 file against (a)–(c) before its signature is cited. A file that does not meet them is not cited as A5's ratification until it does. If the real assessment ratifies a const-enforced rule without addressing the absent case, Q0's recommendation is withdrawn rather than re-conditioned (q0-a5-benchmark-2026-10-10.md §6). The benchmark counts only once it is on main; until then this run does not sign as A5.
